title: Nides Says Iran War Needs Negotiations
title_cn: 尼德斯称伊朗战争需要谈判
summary: Former US Ambassador to Israel Tom Nides says there is no lasting military solution to the conflict with Iran, arguing that renewed negotiations involving regional allies offer the only realistic path to reopening the Strait of Hormuz and addressing Tehran's nuclear program. He also says regime change in Iran is not a practical near-term objective and that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces growing domestic political pressure as the conflict continues without a clear resolution. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed the Week of 8/02
title_cn: 顺便说一句：您可能错过了 8 月 2 日这一周的头条新闻
summary: Younger Chinese professionals moving away from the traditional baijiu drinking culture, premium bottled water gaining traction with wellness-focused consumers, and historic government buildings across Europe being converted into luxury hotels. Bloomberg News' Nathan Hager joins David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to share headlines you may have missed. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wall Street’s Favorite Bet Comes Undone as Chips Whipsaw Market
title_cn: 华尔街最喜欢的赌注因芯片洗盘市场而落空
summary: The one-way trade in semiconductor stocks that has defined equity markets this year is coming unglued, triggering stomach-churning volatility as investors grow increasingly concerned that the fire-hose of artificial intelligence spending won’t continue.

title: SpaceX IPO Faces First Reality Check
title_cn: SpaceX 首次公开募股面临首次现实检验
summary: Bloomberg Space Reporter Loren Grush says investors will use SpaceX's first public earnings report to gauge progress on Starship, Starlink, AI infrastructure and the company's long-term growth strategy following its blockbuster IPO. She says Starship's latest test marks meaningful progress, but major technical hurdles remain before the rocket can support rapid reuse and ambitious missions to the Moon and Mars. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Yen Traders Brace for More Intervention With US at Japan’s Side
title_cn: 日元交易者准备迎接美国在日本方面进行更多干预
summary: Currency traders are on high alert for more joint intervention by Japan and the US when trading gets underway in Asia on Monday after coordinated operations in Tokyo and New York last week triggered a dramatic rebound in the yen.

title: Ugly Month in Emerging Markets May Be a Taste of What’s Ahead
title_cn: 新兴市场的糟糕月份可能预示着未来的发展
summary: Investors’ hopes of a stellar year in emerging markets are being tested by a bruising July that may offer a taste of the headwinds ahead.

title: Trump Pauses Iran Strikes as Talks Resume
title_cn: 特朗普暂停对伊朗的打击，恢复谈判
summary: Bloomberg's Jeff Mason and Dan Williams say President Donald Trump is pausing planned military action against Iran to allow negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's nuclear program to continue, while warning the pause depends on reaching a deal quickly. They say Israel remains cautious, Gulf states are increasingly pursuing their own security strategies, and any agreement on shipping through Hormuz could reshape the regional balance of power even as broader conflicts in Gaza and Lebanon continue. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: This Surgical Robot Could Transform the Operating Room
title_cn: 这种手术机器人可以改变手术室
summary: After spending years and hundreds of millions of dollars, Johnson and Johnson has won FDA approval for its new surgical robot Ottava. Can it challenge the dominance of competitors who entered the race years earlier, or is the market already spoken for? (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bomb Kills Three, Injures 21 at Restaurant on Moscow’s Kudrinskaya Square
title_cn: 莫斯科库德林斯卡亚广场餐厅发生炸弹袭击，造成 3 人死亡、21 人受伤
summary: Three people were killed and 21 injured after a bomb was detonated in an upscale restaurant in central Moscow on Saturday night, according to Russia’s National Anti-Terrorism Committee.

title: Trump Says US to Hold Off Iran Attack If Deal Agreed
title_cn: 特朗普表示如果达成协议美国将阻止伊朗袭击
summary: President Donald Trump said the US will hold off new strikes against Iran after the Islamic Republic and other Middle Eastern nations told him they’re working toward a deal.

title: Banks Offload Risk from Leveraged ETFs With Exotic ‘Crash Puts’
title_cn: 银行通过异国情调的“崩盘”来减轻杠杆ETF的风险
summary: Leveraged ETFs that offer the tantalizing prospect of doubling or tripling the daily returns of an individual stock are famously risky for investors who buy them.

title: ANZ, NAB Among Banks Funding Blackstone HSBC Book Buy, AFR Says
title_cn: AFR 表示，澳新银行 (ANZ)、澳大利亚国民银行 (NAB) 等银行为黑石汇丰银行 (Blackstone HSBC) 图书购买提供资金
summary: ANZ Group Holdings Ltd. and National Australia Bank Ltd. are among lenders bankrolling Blackstone Inc.’s A$36 billion ($25.3 billion) purchase of HSBC Holdings Plc’s Australian retail loan portfolio, the Australian Financial Review reported Sunday, citing unnamed sources.

title: Modi Opposes Court Cases For Protesters, Urges Forgiveness
title_cn: 莫迪反对对抗议者提起诉讼，敦促宽恕
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi said he opposed punishment and court proceedings for the young protesters who marched in New Delhi and other Indian cities in recent weeks, saying “children make mistakes” and society should “forgive” them for using foul language.

title: Saudi Prince Concerned Over Trump’s Iran Strike Plan: Axios
title_cn: 沙特王子对特朗普的伊朗打击计划表示担忧：Axios
summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman told President Donald Trump in a call that he was concerned over the US’s plans for new strikes against Iran, Axios reported, citing people familiar with the conversation.

title: Crushed by Kospi Rout, Angry Koreans Rip Lee and Vow Not to Buy
title_cn: 被 Kospi Rout 压垮，愤怒的韩国人撕破李誓不买
summary: South Korea’s retail traders have long built a reputation for embracing risk. Yet July’s punishing reversal in the Kospi has rattled even this battle-hardened cohort, exposing the limits of their tolerance for volatility.

title: AI Loan Market Sees Investor Demands Rise, Borrowers Offer Better Terms
title_cn: 人工智能贷款市场投资者需求上升，借款人提供更好的条件
summary: Loan investors are pushing back for the first time in years, in a shift that will probably translate to higher borrowing costs for everyone from private equity firms to deeply indebted AI companies.

title: Bloomberg This Weekend 08/01/2026
summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Tim Stenovec bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Seaport Research Partners Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub, Utah Governor Spencer Cox, Maryland Governor Wes Moore, Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt, Delaware Matt Meyer, the New Yorker Editor David Remnick, Fmr. US Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor, Schwab Center for Financial Research Head of Macro Research & Strategy Kevin Gordon and Author & Financial Expert, Benna401(k) CEO, “Father of 401(K)” Ted Benna. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bipartisan Governors Launch Task Force to Tackle Immigration Reform
title_cn: 两党州长成立特别工作组来解决移民改革问题
summary: From Oklahoma City, the site of the annual meeting of the National Governor’s Association, Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt, Maryland Governor Wes Moore, Utah Governor Spencer Cox, and Delaware Governor Matt Meyer joined Bloomberg This Weekend host Christina Ruffini to announce the launching of a bi-partisan immigration task force to find solutions to one of America's most politically divisive issues. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pointed! Bloomberg's Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
title_cn: 尖！彭博社针对冒险者的每周新闻测验
summary: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Join Bloomberg's David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Tim Stenovec as they play and check out the quiz for yourself at Bloomberg.com (Source: Bloomberg)

title: The Father of 401(k) Has A New Retirement Plan
title_cn: 401(k) 之父制定了新的退休计划
summary: Known as the "Father of 401(k)" Ted Benna has co-created Radish: a new employer-funded retirement plan that allows employees to access funds for immediate financial needs such as car repairs or medical expenses without relying on paycheck deductions. Joining David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend, Benna explains that while the original 401(k) succeeded in transforming workers into savers, many people now lack the financial ability to contribute. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jefferies Analyst Slams Simple-Minded Criticism of SpaceX Governance
title_cn: Jefferies 分析师猛烈抨击对 SpaceX 治理的简单批评
summary: Investors who blacklist Space Exploration Technologies Corp. out of governance qualms are too hung up on box-checking and risk depriving themselves of long-term financial gains, according to Aniket Shah of Jefferies.

title: Zepto Turns to Private Funding With IPO Plans on Hold for Now
title_cn: Zepto 转向私募融资，IPO 计划暂时搁置
summary: Zepto Ltd said it agreed on a private share sale to major investors as the Indian quick-commerce firm pushed back plans for an initial public offering after failing to secure its anticipated valuation.

title: Trump Holds Off Iran Strikes on Pledge a Hormuz Deal Is Close
title_cn: 特朗普推迟对伊朗发动袭击，承诺即将达成霍尔木兹海峡协议
summary: US President Donald Trump said he’s holding off from new strikes on Iran, after Tehran and other Middle Eastern powers told him they’re working on an agreement that might quickly reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Anwar’s Bloc Loses Control of Another Malaysian State
title_cn: 安瓦尔集团失去对另一个马来西亚国家的控制
summary: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s coalition lost a key state election to the once-dominant Barisan Nasional, raising fresh doubts about his political standing ahead of the next general polls.

title: Morocco Says Trump Highway Naming Is Mark of ‘Deep Appreciation’
title_cn: 摩洛哥称特朗普高速公路命名是“深切欣赏”的标志
summary: Moroccan King Mohammed VI said his decision to give US President Donald Trump’s name to a $1 billion highway that crosses into the disputed Western Sahara expresses his “deep appreciation” of the American leader.

title: Hungary Stops Nuclear Plant for First Time as Danube Dries Up
title_cn: 多瑙河干涸后匈牙利首次停止核电站
summary: Hungary is fully shutting down its sole nuclear power plant for the first time due to the record low levels of the Danube River, straining energy supplies and posing a major test for the economy and new Prime Minister Peter Magyar.

title: Katayama to Say Japan, US Are Coordinating to Curb Yen Weakness
title_cn: 片山称日本和美国正在协调遏制日元疲软
summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama is set to announce as early as Monday that Tokyo and Washington are coordinating on steps in the foreign exchange market to curb the yen’s weakness, a person familiar with the situation said.

title: Venezuela Starts US-Backed Talks on Future Democratic Elections
title_cn: 委内瑞拉开始美国支持的未来民主选举谈判
summary: Venezuela’s government and some opposition members formally launched a US-backed political dialogue that could establish the terms for future democratic elections.

title: Michigan Reports Hacks on Water Systems Amid FBI Probe
title_cn: 密歇根州报告联邦调查局调查期间供水系统遭到黑客攻击
summary: Michigan joined Minnesota in announcing cyberattacks on its state water supply, saying nine systems were the target of attacks that intelligence officials have blamed on Iran.

title: Trump Rebukes DOJ Ally Pirro for Dropping Reflecting Pool Case
title_cn: 特朗普斥责司法部盟友皮罗放弃反光池案
summary: President Donald Trump faulted Jeanine Pirro, his handpicked federal prosecutor for Washington, DC, for dropping a criminal charge against a former Olympian accused of damaging the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

title: Trump Pushes $1.8 Billion DOJ Fund Over Blanche Nomination
title_cn: 特朗普因布兰奇提名而向司法部拨款 18 亿美元
summary: President Donald Trump doubled down on his commitment to a $1.8 billion fund to help his supporters, saying he’d now work with Congress to make it federal law — even if it costs him his nominee for US attorney general.

title: Sanchez Isolated After Spain Sparks Fear of Migration Crisis
title_cn: 西班牙引发移民危机恐惧后桑切斯被孤立
summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has been the most progressive European leader on migration, bucking his colleagues’ rightward shift. That stance has now left him politically exposed after thousands of migrants overran a Spanish enclave in Northern Africa.

title: Spain Slams ‘Selfish’ EU Responses to Ceuta Migrant Chaos
title_cn: 西班牙抨击欧盟对休达移民混乱的“自私”反应
summary: Spain’s prime minister denounced what he called a “selfish, polarizing and unlawful” reaction from some European Union member states to this week’s mass influx of immigrants to the Northern African enclave of Ceuta that’s governed by Madrid.

title: US Soldier Rejects Polymarket Maduro Wager Charges, Calls Case ‘Overzealous’
title_cn: 美国士兵拒绝Polymarket马杜罗赌注指控，称案件“过于热心”
summary: The US Army soldier charged with making winning Polymarket predictions based on classified information about the raid to capture then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro asked a judge to throw out the case, saying the alleged bets aren’t a crime.

title: Bipartisan Group of Governors Joins Forces to Tackle Immigration
title_cn: 两党州长小组联手解决移民问题
summary: A bipartisan group of governors is launching an immigration task force to develop policy recommendations for Congress, seeking common ground at a time when deep partisan divisions have stalled immigration reform at the federal level.
